title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) doubtful to return
items.desc: The Bills have downgraded WR DJ Moore (shoulder) to doubtful to return against New England.
items.impact: Moore was injured in the second quarter and appears unlikely to return. Moore has been dealing with a shoulder injury over the last few weeks. He will end the day with one reception for 11 yards if he does not return.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of the Week 4 contest between the Philadelphia Eagles and Los Angeles Rams according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Barkley will remain sidelined after suffering the hamstring injury in the first half Sunday, carrying the ball twice for eight yards and catching his lone target for two yards prior to exiting. Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley take over backfield duties for head coach Nick Sirianni.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) questionable to return
items.desc: Packers RB Chris Brooks (ankle) is questionable to return against Tampa Bay.
items.impact: Brooks exits the game in the second quarter as the leading rusher for the Packers. MarShawn Lloyd will serve as the primary running back with Brooks sidelined.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase headed to the locker room
items.desc: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase is headed to the locker room. He is now being evaluated for a concussion and is questionable to return.
items.impact: Chase suffered an apparent injury on the Bengals' last possession after a face mask penalty by a Jaguars' defender. The Bengals will turn to Tee Higgins as the primary pass catcher if Chase cannot return.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (back) officially active for Week 4
items.desc: Jets TE Kenyon Sadiq (back) is officially active for a Week 4 matchup with the Bears.
items.impact: Sadiq was limited in each practice session this week but has been cleared to play Sunday. The rookie should see plenty of opportunities with WR Adonai Mitchell and RB Breece Hall both inactive Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Eli Raridon (thigh) officially active for Week 4
items.desc: Patriots TE Eli Raridon (thigh) is officially active for a Week 4 matchup with the Bills.
items.impact: Raridon missed Week 3 with a thigh injury that he suffered in Week 2, but is good to go for key divisional matchup with the Bills. The rookie tight end should continue to rotate in behind veteran Hunter Henry.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chris Moore (ankle) officially inactive for Week 4
items.desc: Ravens WR Chris Moore (ankle) is officially inactive for a Week 4 matchup with the Titans.
items.impact: Moore was limited in each session of practice this week and was considered questionable to play Sunday. The Ravens will likely turn to Devontez Walker to serve as a replacement for Moore in the lineup.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) officially active for Week 4
items.desc: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 4 matchup with the Titans.
items.impact: Flowers was tagged as questionable after being limited in practice twice this week. Fantasy managers should expect the Ravens' WR1 to see his usual share of targets against a struggling Titans' team.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Lane Johnson (personal) officially inactive for Week 4
items.desc: Eagles OT Lane Johnson (personal) is officially inactive for Week 4.
items.impact: Johnson was a late add to the injury report and tagged as questionable Sunday. With both Lane and Fred Johnson out, the Eagles are very thin on the bench at offensive tackle against the Rams.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ray Davis (hamstring) officially active for Week 4
items.desc: Bills RB Ray Davis (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 4 matchup with the Patriots.
items.impact: Davis was a mid-week addition to the injury report and was questionable to play Sunday. Davis and Ty Johnson will continue to backup James Cook in a divisional matchup with New England.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyjae Spears (ankle) officially active for Week 4
items.desc: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (ankle) is officially active for a Week 4 matchup with the Ravens.
items.impact: Spears was listed as questionable to play Sunday, but his full practice Friday was encouraging. He will work with Tony Pollard out of the Titans' backfield in a tough matchup against Baltimore.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Marcus Mariota (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Marcus Mariota (knee) has been ruled out for the remainder of the Week 4 contest between the Washington Commanders and Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Mariota will not return after suffering a right knee injury on a first-quarter sack, with rookie Athan Kaliakmanis taking over under center against the Colts for head coach Dan Quinn.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) planning on full workload Sunday
items.desc: Puka Nacua (groin) is expected to receive a full workload for the Los Angeles Rams against the Philadelphia Eagles Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Nacua has missed the last games due to groin and hip injuries, but seems poised for a return to a major role in the Los Angeles passing attack barring any setbacks for head coach Sean McVay against the Eagles Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) to miss extended time
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (thumb) is expected to miss between three and six weeks according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Mayfield's timeline remains dependent on the quarterback's ability to grip the football according to Schefter, suffering the injury in Week 3. Rookie signal caller Jalon Daniels will start behind center for head coach Todd Bowles beginning in Week 4 against the Green Bay Packers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Austin Ekeler active for Week 4
items.desc: Austin Ekeler is active for Week 4 for the Washington Commanders against the Indianapolis Colts according to John Keim.
items.impact: Ekeler will suit up after being unable being signed to the active roster earlier in the week, with the veteran running back looking to make an impact out of the Washington backfield behind Jacory Croskey-Merritt and Kaytron Allen with Rachaad White sidelined for head coach Dan Quinn against the Colts.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) expected to play on Sunday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot, rib) is expected to play on Sunday against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Ladd is battling through several injuries right now, but he is expected to push through them and play. The Chargers offense desperately needs him, because without him, the offense is unable to move the ball effectively.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) unlikely to play on Sunday
items.desc: Jalen Coker (quad) who is listed as questionable due to a quad injury, is unlikely to play Sunday against the Lions.
items.impact: If Coker sits, Tetairoa McMillan and Darren Waller are priority starts against a weak Lions secondary in a game that profiles as a shootout. Brycen Tremayne is another name to watch in deeper leagues, as he will likely see an aexpanded role if Coker does in fact sit.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ashton Dulin (ankle) active for Week 4
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (ankle) is active for Week 4 for the Indianapolis Colts against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Dulin will take the field after logging full practice sessions Thursday and Friday while carrying a questionable designation into the weekend, poised for an uptick in snaps with Keenan Allen ruled out earlier for the Week 4 contest for head coach Shane Steichen.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) inactive for Week 4
items.desc: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is officially inactive for Week 4 for the Washington Commanders against the Indianapolis Colts according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: McLaurin will not suit up after being unable to progress throughout the week from a hamstring injury suffered in Week 3. Veteran Stefon Diggs slides into a WR1 role for head coach Dan Quinn, with Antonio Williams also expected to see increased targets against the Colts Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'seem Reed elevated from Panthers practice squad
items.desc: The Panthers elevated WR Ja'Seem Reed from the practice squad.
items.impact: This move puts into question the status of WR Jalen Coker, who remains listed as questionable.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Panthers placed WR Xavier Legette on injured reserve.
items.impact: Legette was already ruled out for Week 4. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) placed on IR
items.desc: The Seahawks placed RB Jadarian Price on injured reserve.
items.impact: Price aggravated a chest injury during Wednesday's practice. He will now miss at least four games. Emanuel Wilson and George Holani will lead the backfield with Zach Charbonnet returning as early as next week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Keenan Allen (groin) out for Week 4
items.desc: Keenan Allen (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Allen has been listed as questionable on Friday, but the veteran will indeed sit out Sunday's game. With both Allen and Alec Pierce out of action, the Colts are very thin at wide receiver. Look for Josh Downs and tight end Tyler Warren to be heavily targeted by QB Daniel Jones. Veterans Laquon Treadwell and Darius Slayton could be in the mix as well.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) aiming for Week 5 return
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) optimistic about returning in Week 5.
items.impact: Jefferson has already been ruled out for Week 4, but the Vikings are planning to try to get him back on the field for Week 5's matchup with the Saints. Jefferson is still rehabbing his injured ankle this weekend and hopes to return to the practice field next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Donald dealing with 'mild' back injury
items.desc: Aaron Donald is reportedly dealing with a "mild" back injury.
items.impact: Donald can be considered as week-to-week for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyson Bagent expected to start in Week 4 for Bears
items.desc: QB Tyson Bagent is expected to start for the Bears in Week 4 against the Jets.
items.impact: It is a bit surprising following a big performance for Case Keenum last week. Bagent took the majority of first-team reps this week. The announcement should be made official this weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Mims remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Dobbins will remain a touchdown dependent low-end RB2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (foot) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Waddle was seen in a walking boot after last Sunday's win. He will be a WR2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Porter is officially good to go to make his season debut immediately after getting traded to Dallas.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrell Jennings works out for Steelers
items.desc: Free agent RB Terrell Jennings worked out for the Steelers on Friday.
items.impact: Jennings would add depth in the backfield for Pittsburgh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (quad) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Dre Greenlaw is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Greenlaw's status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mykel Williams (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Mykel Williams has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Williams remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent Williams (neck) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Trent Williams is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Williams is officially good to go after leaving last week's game early.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Sweat (groin) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Josh Sweat is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Sweat was downgraded to a limited practice on Friday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalvin Tomlinson (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Dalvin Tomlinson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Tomlinson will be sidelined with a hamstring injury.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Julian Love (calf) available to play Sunday
items.desc: Julian Love (calf) will be available to play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Love should be good to go for Sunday's game, which was to be expected after he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Friday. Seattle's defense will be pretty healthy this week and should continue to perform as one of the NFL's best units in a matchup against the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: The veteran was able to practice twice this week, but that's not enough to give the team the confidence they need to play him this week, so he will remain out against the Chargers. Fantasy managers should expect Charbonnet to be back in the lineup sometime within the next few weeks, however, which will mean less work for Emmanuel Wilson and Jadarian Price (chest) moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Holani (rib) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: George Holani (rib) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Holani's rib injury isn't serious at this point and won't prevent him from playing in Week 4. He will continue to split the backfield with Emmanuel Wilson now that rookie Jadarian Price (chest) has been ruled out for this matchup against the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) will play Sunday
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) will play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Emmanwori will be available to play on Sunday, which was to be expected after he practiced in a full capacity all week. He will continue to be a key contributor for this elite defense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kayode Awosika (leg) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Kayode Awosika (leg) will be unavailable to play in Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: The Chargers will be down a starting lineman on Sunday, with Awosika set to be sidelined for another game due to a leg injury of some kind. Their offensive line seems likely to struggle against a very tough Seahawks' defense this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Lance (groin) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Trey Lance (groin) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Lance is officially questionable for Sunday's game due to a groin issue that he's battling with. He's still the QB2 behind Justin Herbert, however, so his absence wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Los Angeles' star safety may not be available to play on Sunday. James is currently dealing with a hamstring injury and is considered questionable as a result. Their secondary will be much weaker than usual if he's unable to suit up against the reigning Super Bowl champions in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keaton Mitchell (ankle) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell (ankle) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: The veteran is going to be good to go on Sunday, despite being listed on the injury report throughout the week due to an ankle issue. He will continue to play second fiddle behind Omarion Hampton on this offense, although his exact snap share remains worth keeping an eye on this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Thompson is not going to be available to play on Sunday due to the quad injury that he's dealing with. The Chargers are set to be thinner than usual at the wideout position this week, especially if Ladd McConkey (foot) is also ruled out for this matchup against Seattle.
